newsitem.title: USA: J.M. SMUCKER SEES Q1 SALES, EARNINGS RISE.
newsitem.headline: J.M. SMUCKER SEES Q1 SALES, EARNINGS RISE.

text.p: J.M. Smucker Co, the leading U.S. maker of jams, jellies and related products, said Tuesday it expects sales for the first quarter of fiscal 1998 ended July 31 to be up about 14 percent and earnings up 25 percent from the same period a year ago.
Richard Smucker, president, told shareholders at their annual meeting that the results reflect good performance by all of the company's businesses, especially its consumer and industrial divisions.
Smucker noted that the company had finished the prior fiscal year with a strong fourth quarter, and preliminary indications show that the trend was continuing in the first quarter of the new year.
The final earnings report for the first quarter is expected to be issued within the next week, he said.
First Call's mean earnings per share estimate for the company's first quarter, 1998, is $0.32.
